description: Defines the Item class representing an item with properties such as name, author, filename, and URLs for large and thumbnail images. Includes a static list of items and methods for retrieving items and their properties.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents an item with name, author, filename, and URLs for associated images. Provides methods for accessing item properties and a static list of predefined items.

methods.name: Item(String, String, String)
methods.description: Constructor initializing an Item instance with name, author, and filename.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier based on hash codes of name and filename.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Returns the author of the item.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the item.

methods.name: getPhotoUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the large image.

methods.name: getThumbnailUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the thumbnail image.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an Item object matching a given id from the static ITEMS array.
